The revelation sequence · 庚 The Blade · golden chart

Painting the revelation

The sequence a new reader sees once: the Naming, then the first reading's cards, then the dissolve into Your reading. Below is how it looks today, what the painting system and the type rulings now ask of it, and three ways to bring them in. The storyboards use the real paintings and the real copy; the type and button layouts are sketches to rule, not built screens.

Today, on the dev build

  • Bare paper. Every card is a short block of words in the middle of the page; most leave well over 40% of the screen empty, against the rule you set for the Day Master page.
  • None of the new paintings. The energy cards show only the ink dot, though the Blade's five scrolls now tell exactly these relations.
  • The Blade is named twice. The Naming says "The Blade", and card 1 opens with "You are The Blade."
  • No type. The Elementum Type (Mind mode, what you need, your circle) and its share moment never appear, though the sequence is where a new reader would first meet it.
  • The Naming's ground is the generic distant peaks and floating island, the same for every stem.

Reply with one code (A, B or C), or a code plus changes. Ruled: A, with the larger five-energy sign and the dominance bar on each energy card. My pick was A: it keeps the rhythm you ruled in RS1, fills every card with the stem's own paintings, says the name once, and lands on the type as the share moment. B is the most beautiful idea but the longest build; C reaches the share fastest but rushes the reading.

A

The painted scroll

Ruled

Keep the shape you ruled in RS1 (one ground, the Naming then eight cards) and paint it with the locked system. The Naming stands on the Blade's own minimal stage instead of the generic peaks. Card 1 becomes the sign, with its D1 painting, so the name is not said twice. Each energy card carries the Blade's scroll for that energy down its left side, so the relation is a picture, not only a sentence. Card 8 lands on the type, where to begin, and a share button. Every card is filled; nothing new to learn. Ruled with changes: on each energy card the five-energy sign is enlarged into the card's leading icon, with the amount beside it, and the dominance bar shows all five energies with this one lit, so the reader sees how much of it they hold.

B

The unrolling handscroll

The five energies become one long horizontal painting (手卷) that the reader unrolls sideways, pausing on each encounter. The most immersive and the most traditional, but it is a new gesture to learn, the longest build, and it needs a continuous painting per stem rather than five strips.

C

The type first

A short, share-led sequence: the Naming, all five energies on one card, run plus mode plus need on one card, then the type card to share. Fastest to the viral moment (four cards), but the energies get one glance each and the slower first-reading rhythm you ruled in RS1 is lost.
